thread:
lucy: quick RFC follow-up: decide capability discovery pattern for Hosted/Dedicated/Private. prefer one canonical approach.

devin: single pattern + fallbacks. probe endpoint for hosted/dedicated, static manifest for private installers.

maria: agree. precedence: manifest -> probe -> conservative default. manifest avoids outbound deps for air-gapped.

ashok: capability schema: name + semver + params (no booleans). probe must use signed ephemeral token, rate-limited, minimal logs.

devin: sample manifest: capabilities:
  - name: streaming_v2
    min_version: "2.0"
  - name: kv_cache
    min_version: "1.1"
    params: "max_prefix=256"

lucy: rollout plan: spec v1, SDK reads manifest then probe, runtime gate features, emit telemetry on missing capabilities, canary hosted 5% + one dedicated cluster.

maria: ops checklist: update deploy manifests, create PKI tokens, update quickstart. I'll own docs + compatibility matrix.

devin: clients cache capabilities with TTL (5m default). avoid probing per request.

lucy: also warn if capabilities change mid-run (config drift). decision: dual-support + clear precedence, schema-first negotiation, auth for probe, test harness + canary. closing.
